player_prompt.intro:
Oli omuzannyi {player_id} mu SimpleTak.
Ku boodi, amakubiro go ganabagana nga '{player_stone}' na amakubiro ga mukwano wo ganabagana nga '{opponent_stone}'.

Ku luzannya, linga saala limu (kwa namunigina yake) na weza amakubiro go mu saala.
Kwa nnekyera, '[12]' kuyita amakubiro go mu saala 12.

Ekigendererwa kyo kukola ennyambula ya amakubiro go egikwatagana egisambira ebitundu bibiri ebyenkanja bya boodi (ku ntongo-ku ntongo oba ku ddyo-ku ddyo).

invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Ennamba ya kasirise etakkirizibwa {cell_num}. Erina okubeera wakati wa 0 ne {max_board_num}.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Akasenge {cell_num} kale kabadde kajjuddemu. Londa akasenge akataliiko kintu kyonna.

action.placement: Omuzannyi {current_player_id} yaweerezza amakubiro ge ({symbol}) mu saala {cell_num}.
